notes: Couch to 5K uses the NHS nine-stage, 27-session run/walk progression. Three sessions per week normally take at least nine weeks; two per week need at least fourteen weeks, and reviews or repeats can take longer.

The calendar holds your current stage until you confirm all three lessons felt comfortable and review the next stage. Future dates never establish fitness. Keep at least one rest day between sessions.
Begin with comfortable walking. If a one-minute jog is too much, walk, log a partial attempt and repeat; do not chase the next stage or the finish date.

Every session includes a five-minute warm-up walk and five-minute cooldown. The final milestone is 30 minutes of continuous running, not a guaranteed 5 km or race appointment. Pace and distance stay unprescribed.

reasons: Couch to 5K stage 1 of 9. Future sessions repeat this stage until a comfortable completion review unlocks the next. 27 lessons remain before the 30-minute milestone, before allowing repeats. This finish date does not leave enough scheduled sessions to complete the course; continue in a later block. Thirty minutes is not necessarily 5 km.

notes: Couch to 5K uses the NHS nine-stage, 27-session run/walk progression. Three sessions per week normally take at least nine weeks; two per week need at least fourteen weeks, and reviews or repeats can take longer.

The calendar holds your current stage until you confirm all three lessons felt comfortable and review the next stage. Future dates never establish fitness. Keep at least one rest day between sessions.
Begin with comfortable walking. If a one-minute jog is too much, walk, log a partial attempt and repeat; do not chase the next stage or the finish date.

Every session includes a five-minute warm-up walk and five-minute cooldown. The final milestone is 30 minutes of continuous running, not a guaranteed 5 km or race appointment. Pace and distance stay unprescribed.

reasons: Couch to 5K stage 1 of 9. Future sessions repeat this stage until a comfortable completion review unlocks the next. 27 lessons remain before the 30-minute milestone, before allowing repeats. This finish date does not leave enough scheduled sessions to complete the course; continue in a later block. Thirty minutes is not necessarily 5 km.

workouts.reason: Repeat the current stage until all three lessons feel comfortable and your progress review is complete. Walk or stop if needed; record partial attempts honestly. No catch-up sessions.

distanceEstimate.basis: No reliable pace supplied; duration and effort are prescribed.

notes: Couch to 5K uses the NHS nine-stage, 27-session run/walk progression. Three sessions per week normally take at least nine weeks; two per week need at least fourteen weeks, and reviews or repeats can take longer.

The calendar holds your current stage until you confirm all three lessons felt comfortable and review the next stage. Future dates never establish fitness. Keep at least one rest day between sessions.
Begin with comfortable walking. If a one-minute jog is too much, walk, log a partial attempt and repeat; do not chase the next stage or the finish date.

Every session includes a five-minute warm-up walk and five-minute cooldown. The final milestone is 30 minutes of continuous running, not a guaranteed 5 km or race appointment. Pace and distance stay unprescribed.

reasons: The 30-minute running milestone is complete. This does not establish a measured 5 km distance.

notes: Couch to 5K uses the NHS nine-stage, 27-session run/walk progression. Three sessions per week normally take at least nine weeks; two per week need at least fourteen weeks, and reviews or repeats can take longer.

The calendar holds your current stage until you confirm all three lessons felt comfortable and review the next stage. Future dates never establish fitness. Keep at least one rest day between sessions.
Begin with comfortable walking. If a one-minute jog is too much, walk, log a partial attempt and repeat; do not chase the next stage or the finish date.

Every session includes a five-minute warm-up walk and five-minute cooldown. The final milestone is 30 minutes of continuous running, not a guaranteed 5 km or race appointment. Pace and distance stay unprescribed.

reasons: The 30-minute running milestone is complete. This does not establish a measured 5 km distance.
